paragraphs: Chapter 901
Episode 227. A New Enemy, The Enemy of Enemies (2)
In the Garden of Swords.
"…So that's why you urgently sent me away."
Luna sighed as she spoke.

After vanquishing Ann's physical form, Jin honestly informed Luna about the situation at the time and the current circumstances. As her brothers, whom she thought were suffering in hell, became a new enemy under the name 'Ganesto', there was no need to hide it from Luna anymore.
"I'm sorry, sister. I was afraid it might hurt you."

"No, it's not your fault, youngest. Given my fragile state, it's natural for you to have thought so. Surely, if it were me instead of you, I wouldn't have been able to defeat Ann so quickly. Considering how pitifully he acted, even to the point of making you uncomfortable, I would have suffered much more. I might even have suffered minor injuries."
"Or Ann might have continued to pretend until the very end. Although you would have eventually defeated Ann, the rest of the brothers would have appeared before you in the same way."
If Ann, Mu, Lan, and Vugo all pretended to repent in a ruined state one by one in front of Luna, it would have been a significant psychological blow to her.

"I suppose that could happen. Biseptus gave good information. It's better this way. From now on, I can defeat our dead brothers without remorse. Those guys are rotting to the very end... really to the end. At this point, I even start to think it doesn't matter that I didn't pay more attention when we were young."

"In reality, it has nothing to do with you, sister. If we must find a reason why they were like that before becoming Ganesto, it might be because of the brutal culture of Run Kandel. However, even without that culture, they would have ended up as Ganesto."
- And, send my regards to the brothers. Let them know they are always welcome if they are thinking of defecting. After all, we were all born from the same belly.
As Ann had said, all of the current generation of Run Kandels were born from Rosa, and Rosa is presumed to be a direct descendant of Ganesto.
Jin suspected that among them, those who inherited Ganesto's blood strongly, or those with weak will and dark thoughts, had awakened that blood, like a kind of infection.

At least, in his past life that Jin knew of, there was nothing like that, but he couldn't be sure. At that time, Jin had left the family, and he didn't know the situation of the large powers including Run Kandel as much as he does now.
Many histories have changed due to his return, but somehow he had a strange conviction that this incident was not related to that.
"Damn it, the fact that we were all born from the same belly makes me feel a bit uncomfortable, Sagaju."
"I am wondering if there could be someone among us who suddenly awakens the blood of Ganesto."
Daytona and Haytona frowned as they spoke.

"The possibility isn't exactly non-existent. But if it was possible, there would be no reason for Rokia to go this roundabout way. Awakening the riders here would be much more efficient for her than that side. We either can't awaken or something is preventing our awakening."
"Something is preventing us from awakening as Ganesto..."
When Meri answered Jin, Lret nodded.
[If something is blocking the awakening, I think it might be Sol Deret's power.]
"Sol Deret's power...?"

[Curse immunity. Rokia was the best mage in the Rune Candle, perhaps in the world at the time. Unlike warriors, a mage's ability isn't always evaluated in combat power. Creator, Rokia was called that, showing incredible magic.]
The fact that Rokia was called the 'Creator' was a memory that returned immediately after Jin met Ann.
[She was proficient in more magic than the leaders of Elona and Zipple, especially in curse, there was no one who could follow.]
Lret speculated that Ganesto's blood was a kind of curse.
[If the awakening of the blood is a curse, Sogaju is immune because of Sol Deret's power. And the other jockeys may have become immune thanks to the influence.]
"Hold on, Lret. Curse immunity only applies to the little one."
[That's right. But Sol Deret might have noticed Rokia's betrayal a thousand years ago and prepared for it. Of course, it's just a hypothesis.]

"If that hypothesis is true, even though my brothers and I are immune, one person bothers me. Doctor Kwall. If Sol Deret really prepared, would he be included... Of course, so far, Doctor Kwall has not shown any signs of abnormality, so the likelihood that Rokia cannot awaken as she intends is high."
[I think so too, Sogaju.]
For now, the concern was not about the conditions for awakening Ganesto's blood. At least all the situations indicated that 'it is impossible for Rokia to awaken the rider and Dr. Kwall at will'.
The important thing was the fact that a new enemy, Ganesto, appeared after the named tribe and the Jinma realm.
Jin activated the communication device. The communication was connected to Jangmak.
"Manager, are the Visekps still there?"
{Yes, I will change it immediately.}
{Jin, how did it go?}
For a while, Jin told Visekps about the information he got after meeting Ann. Tillyas and Misol showed quite a bit of surprise as they listened.
{...Hmm, Ganesto? Ragal was clearly thinking of them as simple prisoners, Rune Candle.}
"Could there be a possibility that Ragal Fun captured those four and had some sort of trade with Lokiya Ganesto?"

{Well…… Firstly, the name Lokiya Ganesto isn't widely known in the demon world. Even in your world, due to historical manipulation, she is almost erased from related information. Moreover, for Lokiya to trade with Ragal, it should have been when she was battling with Elona, that is, when she was in the human world. It seems she wouldn't have had such leisure while facing Elona.}

Then, Tillyas added that it would have been impossible for Lokiya to come to hell and negotiate directly. At present, the only ones who can freely travel between hell and the human world would be witches.

{Above all, Ragal lacks that much intelligence. Does Ragal find the secret of Runecandela on his own, recognize the value of the person named Lokiya Ganesto through it, and then plan to pressure the alliance with it? Even if it was Ragal before he was brainwashed by Gito, it would be impossible.}
"So there must be a helper."

{There must be. But…… Among the characters in the demon world, there is no one who can be guessed at all. It doesn't seem like Gito intervened directly either. Let's be cautious and find out for now.}
After finishing the communication, Jin looked at the people gathered in the conference room.

"If Ragal's accomplice is not in the demon world, then it must be Joshua, the old 2nd rider, whom the Black Sword Guild has been continuously pursuing since the Sinjungjeon. But the key is how he accessed Hell…… If Lokiya and the witch are in a cooperative relationship, they would have had enough access."
Just as he said that, he suddenly received a call from Tikan.
{Lord Jin, I just received a report from Lady Yona.}
"What was it about?"
{It seems that Ainas Caligo and Wizard Pirophs Bahama tried to infiltrate Kellyak's dream together. But there was a strange content.}
-Ah, Bubar. I really didn't want to do it, but you know I used my dream ability for dad's face, right? But it was in vain. Kellyak Ziphil is now, too far away.
-Too far away?

-It means it's not a human world. Even though I confirmed in the dream realm that Kellyak's dream exists, it doesn't show at all, so it's not a middle world. If it were in the middle world, it should at least be vaguely visible. Anyway, I just used the ability I didn't want to use, dad is a fool.
-Keke, don't hate Mr. Pirophs too much. Mr. Pirophs is good to me.
-I'm not hating, I'm just annoyed. I like swords, but they keep telling me to practice dream abilities. And Bubar is my closest friend, so it's only natural that dad treats you well.
The conversation Yona heard after Ainas failed to infiltrate Kellyak's dream. Yona had been doggedly following the two, and had gotten good information this time as well.
If Ainas is correct, there is only one place where Kellyak can be now.
"Hell...... Kellyak Ziphil, he is currently in hell."
"Lady Ameris also said that would be the case when she heard this news."
"Was there anything else?"
"There was nothing else."
"Understood. Once this meeting concludes, I will head to Tikan and deliver the summarized contents, so please wait."
"Yes, Master."
The communication device was turned off.

"Not only Joshua, but Kelliac Jifel may also be collaborating with Ragal Fun. And probably, Joshua and Kelliac are now in one defeat. It would be a situation where there is no harm in relying on each other."
"Hah! Are those who have fallen into hell banding together and plotting something?"
"Guess so, Murakan. Anyway, if they really teamed up, it would be a foregone conclusion to manifest Tes through Shinu's power."
Then, a third communication request came in to the Garden of Swords.
This time it was from Valeria.
"Jin. I've just checked all the records about Anne left in the Oken Desert."
As soon as Jin finished the battle, Valeria went to the Oken Desert and started the investigation.
"I couldn't find out when Anne changed like that, or what she experienced in hell from the record magic. But this record appeared. There were also unexpected names."
'<Kelliac Jifel sends Anne Ganesto to Inse along with Joshua Ganesto.>'
'<After losing her physical body to Jin Runckendel, the soul of Anne Ganesto returned to 'Lokia's world'.'
As Valeria explained the records, the eyes of those in the meeting room widened.
"Lokia's world...? Could it be that she, like Lord Kaitam, has created her own realm in another dimension or subspace?"

"[...As the master said, Kelliac Jifel and Joshua have joined hands. And looking at the reaction of the Demon King, Siker, who was in the Oken Desert, he probably didn't know that Ragal was plotting something with Kelliac, Joshua.]"
"Zito may not know about Joshua, Kelliac, Ragal."
Suddenly, such a thought crossed Jin's mind.
Perhaps the biggest enemy in this war could end up being Kelliac and the Ganesto family, rather than Zito and the Demon Kings.

"Anyway, it doesn't seem like Kelliac and the Ganesto family will play the role of loyal servants to Zito. They will just use the Demon World as much as they can. We need to closely monitor what they are up to within the Demon World going forward."
